mapper.select: SELECT R.*, ( SELECT M.CONTENT FROM MEDIA M WHERE M.PLACE_ID = R.ID AND M.TYPE = 'image' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS thumbnail_url FROM RESTAURANT R WHERE R.ID = #{id}
SELECT R.*, ( SELECT M.CONTENT FROM MEDIA M WHERE M.PLACE_ID = R.ID AND M.TYPE = 'image' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS thumbnail_url FROM RESTAURANT R ORDER BY R.PLACE_NAME

SELECT R.*, ( SELECT M.CONTENT FROM MEDIA M WHERE M.PLACE_ID = R.ID AND M.TYPE = 'image' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS thumbnail_url FROM RESTAURANT R WHERE R.PLACE_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR R.ROAD_ADDRESS_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR R.CATEGORY_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ORDER BY R.PLACE_NAME
SELECT CONTENT FROM MEDIA WHERE PLACE_ID = #{placeId} AND TYPE = 'image' AND ROWNUM = 1
SELECT R.*, ( SELECT M.CONTENT FROM MEDIA M WHERE M.PLACE_ID = R.ID AND M.TYPE = 'image' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS thumbnail_url FROM RESTAURANT R

SELECT r.id, r.place_name, r.road_address_name, r.phone, r.x, r.y, m.content AS thumb FROM restaurant r LEFT JOIN ( SELECT place_id, content FROM ( SELECT place_id, content, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY place_id ORDER BY id) rn FROM media WHERE type = 'image' ) WHERE rn = 1 ) m ON r.id = m.place_id
mapper.insert: insert into restaurant(address_name, category_group_code, category_group_name, category_name, distance, id, phone, place_name, place_url, road_address_name, x, y) values(#{address_name},#{category_group_code},#{category_group_name},#{category_name}, NULL,#{id},#{phone},#{place_name},#{place_url},#{road_address_name},#{x},#{y})
mapper.select: select * from restaurant order by id
mapper.update: update restaurant set address_name = #{address_name}, category_group_code = #{category_group_code}, category_group_name = #{category_group_name}, category_name = #{category_name}, phone = #{phone}, place_name = #{place_name}, place_url = #{place_url}, road_address_name = #{road_address_name}, x = #{x}, y = #{y} where id = #{id}
